newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seyang says still mulls seeking court receivership.
newsitem.headline: Seyang says still mulls seeking court receivership.

text.p: South Korea's Seyang Shipping Co Ltd said on Friday it had not yet decided on whether to seek court receivership but would announce a decision by February 5.
The Korea Stock Exchange said in a statement trading in Seyang shares would be suspended till the company announcement.
The company earlier said it planned to make a decision on the receivership by Thursday due to financial difficulties following the failure of Hanbo Steel Co.
Seyang said its problem stemmed from the fact that its largest shareholder was a brother-in-law of the founder of the Hanbo Group. Hanbo Steel is the conglomerate's flagship.
Hanbo Steel, South Korea's second largest steelmaker, defaulted on debt repayments last week and is seeking court receivership. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727-5646
